specs.title: TC34 | Served build matches its package and cannot switch implementation
TC01 | Approved earnings aggregate into one payment per employee
TC02 | Opening Monday midnight is included
TC03 | Following Monday midnight belongs to the next period
TC04 | Lagos offset is normalized before period selection
TC05 | Reimporting an identical earning never increases pay
TC06 | Conflicting duplicate rolls back the entire import
TC07 | Pending approval blocks payment and leaves the period open
TC08 | Failed payment creates no notification and can be retried
TC09 | Notification failure preserves the successful payment
TC12 | Notification-only recovery never changes payment identity
TC13 | Interruption rolls back payment and outbox together
TC14 | Lost provider acknowledgement recovers without duplicate acceptance
TC15 | A processed period rejects new earnings and preserves approved totals
TC16 | Eight overlapping requests in one server record one payment
TC17 | The same employee can receive a separate payment in another period
TC18 | Invalid dates and ambiguous timestamps are rejected
TC19 | Amounts use positive bounded whole kobo
TC20 | Unknown employees cannot acquire earnings or payments
TC21 | Isolated workspaces do not share earnings or payment identity
TC22 | Approval is explicit and replaying approval is harmless
TC10 | Retrying after notification failure preserves the approved payroll
TC23 | Record, approve and process earnings through the interface
TC24 | Cancelling payroll confirmation leaves the ledger and period unchanged
TC25 | Receipt survives reload and can be copied and downloaded
TC26 | Payment filter and CSV export contain the same employee records
TC27 | Changing pay period separates approval and payment totals
TC28 | Core screens reflow at 320 pixels without page overflow
TC29 | Keyboard navigation reaches content and payroll confirmation
TC30 | Employee details lead to the correct earning destination
TC31 | Payroll screens use product language and show standard totals
TC32 | Notification recovery is visible and leaves the receipt unchanged
TC33 | Separate tabs retain their workspace and pay period after reload
